resource.name: sms-service
resource.description: A shared SMS sending service. It exposes an internal API for sending SMS messages to phone numbers, to be used by any project that needs to notify users via SMS.

config.description: Base URL of the SMS service's internal API, e.g. https://development-default.apps.94.72.97.95.sslip.io/internal-sms-api

resource.consumptionInstructions: Call the service's internal API at its base URL to send SMS messages. Configure the base URL via the SMS_SERVICE_URL config key, then issue requests per the operations defined in its OpenAPI contract (e.g. send an SMS by posting to the send-message endpoint with the recipient number and message body). No further discovery is needed — the contract document lists every available operation and its request/response shape.
